questions.q: What is the smallest prime number?
questions.explanation: 2 is the smallest and only even prime number.

What is the hardest natural substance on Earth?

questions.q: Which element has the atomic number 1?
questions.explanation: Hydrogen has one proton, giving it atomic number 1.

questions.explanation: Albert Einstein published the theory of general relativity in 1915.
